C1379.title: Home Camera Vulnerabilities Lead to Frequent Privacy Breaches
C1379.summary: In 2025, multiple home camera models were found to have severe security flaws, allowing attackers to exploit firmware backdoors to gain root access, view live feeds, or inject malicious code. Many devices were easily compromised due to weak passwords, plaintext transmission, or unpatched CVE vulnerabilities, resulting in user privacy leaks and the public sale of private bedroom footage.

references.title: Home Camera Hacking Incidents Surge: Who Protects User Privacy? - Tencent News
